value.rationale: Root outdegree is local root accessibility and total path length is global search cost. Their joint correlation separates all positive from nonpositive power-weight exponents, a boundary distinct from the known alpha=-1 mean-depth transition. An explicit finite-real alpha*log(n) critical scaling and a square-root emergence law quantify the crossover; a closed alpha=1 constant gives a natural concrete benchmark. These are motivated joint-fluctuation facts rather than merely renaming the source path-variance formula.
